main_text.p: rute, Ibid. verf.36. Futur. יִתְחַבְּרוּ Confociabunt se, Dan. 11.6. cum Kametz propter accentum.

חבר m. Socius, Sodalis, Consors, Prov.28.24. Affix. יָקִים אֶת חֲבֵרוֹ Eriget socium suum, Eccl.4.10. Plur. חֲבֵרִים Cant.8.13. Constr. חֲבֵרֵי נַנְּבִים Socii furum, Jesa.1.23. Aff. חֲבֵרָיו Socii ejus, Jesa.44.11. Chald. חֲבְרָהִי Sociis suis, Dan.2.17. Fœm. חַבְרָת Socia: Aff. וְהִיא חַבְרָתְךָ Et ipsa est socia tua, Mal.2.14. Chald. Plural. מִן חַבְרָתֵיהּ Præ sociis suis, Dan.7.20.
חֵבֶר m. Idem: Plural. חֲבָרִים Socii, Job.40.25.

חֶבֶר m. Societas, Sodalitium, Confociatio, Prov.21.9. Incantatio: חֶבֶר חֶבֶר Incantans incantatione, id est, Utens incantatione, Incantator, Adjurator incantando, Deut.18.11. Plural. חֲבָרִים חֶבֶר Incantans incantationibus, Psal.58.6. Dicitur ut קֶסֶם קֹסְמִים Divinans divinatione, vel, divinationes, id est, Utens divinationibus, Deut.18.10. Aff. בְּעַצְמַת חֲבָרֶיךָ Propter multitudinem incantationum tuarum, Jesa.47.9. Talmudici duplicem faciunt incantationem, Magnam, quâ magna animalia; Parvam, quâ reptilia, serpentes, scorpii, incantando confociantur. Hæc faciens dicitur חוֹבֵר: Sanhedrin fol.65. Meminit horum Kimchi in lib. Radicum. Fœmin. חַבְּרָה Sodalitium, Job.34.8.

הַבּוּרָה f. Plaga, Vibex, Tumor livens, Exod.21.25. Unde Ab.Efra scribit Jesa.1.6. חבורה מכה שתתחבר אליה הלחה Chabbura est plaga in qua cògregatur sanies. Aff. לְחַבֻּרָתִי Ad livorem meum, Gen.4.23. Plural. חֲבֻרוֹת Prov.20.30. Aff. חַבּוּרוֹתַי Vibices mea, Psal.38.6.
חִבּוּרָה f. Idem: Aff. לוֹ וּבַחֲבֻרָתוֹ נִרְפָּא Et in vibice ejus fit curatio nobis, Jesa.35.5.
הוּבָּרָה f. Junctura, Commissura, Exod.26.4. Est forma חַתְמָה Obsignatio, כְּתֶרֶת Cinctura.

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points and some Hebrew headwords are small and faint; they are copied as far as legible and may contain errors. The Latin "Efl" is read as "Est" (long s). Some Hebrew words in the Latin-Hebrew mixed lines (for example in the Chaldee and Aff. forms) are uncertain and not marked individually. The catchword at the bottom right is read as חברורות.
